name: Wolverine WVR-6R — silhouette study
notes: New independent WVR-6R silhouettes with left dorsal six-port rack and right forearm cannon. No inherited humanoid component generator. Shape review 2: remove inaccurate chest port mass, simplify shoulder launcher, keep forearm cannon smaller than whole chest. Reference iteration 3: independently traced ten-sided angular chest and forebody, sloped shoulder cowlings, tall rectangular six-port rack beside helmet, and narrow angular pilot helmet rather than bulbous cylinders. Reference iteration 4: broken-up wide shoulder shields, one clenched fist, distinctly separate cannon shroud in right arm, angular knee/thigh guards and narrower reverse-taper greaves.
